summary: High-performance serving framework for running large language, vision and diffusion models fast in production.

sixtySeconds.whatItDoes: SGLang is an open-source inference framework for large language, vision-language and diffusion models. It is optimised for agentic workloads, large-scale serving and reinforcement learning rollouts.
sixtySeconds.problem: Serving big models quickly and cheaply needs specialised engineering. SGLang provides a fast serving engine used in production by AI labs, cloud platforms, enterprises and universities.
whoFor: ML engineers serving models in production
Teams self-hosting open models on GPUs
sixtySeconds.whyChoose: Choose it for a widely used, fast inference engine with a Docker image, a cookbook of ready launch commands per model and hardware, and an active community.
requirements: An NVIDIA or other supported GPU
Docker, or a Python environment with uv

overview: Pull the lmsysorg/sglang:latest Docker image, which includes SGLang and its dependencies, or install it into an activated Python environment with uv pip install --prerelease=allow sglang.
Then follow the Quickstart to run your first model and send a request, or use the Cookbook to pick your model and hardware and get a ready-to-run launch command.
For development, start from the lmsysorg/sglang:dev image and install your checkout in editable mode. SGLang is Apache 2.0 licensed.
